findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe Archive Extraction (Zip Slip)
 * @description Extracting files from archives without validating the destination path can lead to arbitrary file overwrite.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/zip-slip
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("TarFile").getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember(["open"]).getReturn().getMember(["extract", "extractall"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential unsafe archive extraction. Ensure paths are validated."
findings.hypothesis: Archive extraction (zip/tar) without validating file paths allows writing files outside the intended directory (Zip Slip).

message.text: Potential unsafe archive extraction. Ensure paths are validated.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection
 * @description Detects potential command injection vulnerabilities where untrusted input is passed to system command execution APIs.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution."
findings.hypothesis: Checking for potential command injection sinks in the codebase.
Zip Slip vulnerability where archive member names are used without validation in extract/extractall.

message.text: Potential Zip Slip: member name from [archive member](1) flows to extraction.

 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp", "NamedTemporaryFile", "mkstemp", "mkdtemp"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["mknod", "mkfifo"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially insecure temporary file creation that could be vulnerable to symlink attacks or race conditions."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection from library inputs to subprocess calls.
